name: Health Science Explorers Academy
org: University of Nebraska at Kearney Health Sciences
what_you_do: A year-long program with monthly days on the UNK campus (8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.): hands-on activities, simulations, guest speakers, field trips and health science lessons from UNK and UNMC faculty.
who_can_apply: Students entering 11th or 12th grade who are interested in a health care career. Limited to 25 students.
pay_detail: $100 for the program, with financial help available. Lunch is provided. Students who finish earn a $1,000 UNK scholarship.
duration: September to May, first Wednesday of each month, 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2027-2028 school year opens January 4, 2027. Close date not stated.
how_to_apply: Register online when registration opens on January 4, 2027. Use the link on the Health Science Explorers page. Contact the coordinator listed on the page with questions.
notes: The same page lists a virtual Career Club for grades 9 to 12. It meets on the second Wednesday each month, 7 to 8 pm. It also lists a yearly Health Careers Fair at the Crowne Plaza in Kearney.
